facts.text: Drop Dead Ned, the inn's killer who carries a little killer wasp, is formally hired by the party (fee of 100 gold, about 33 gold each) and is with them in the Barrow Mound, scouting and checking things for them.
Ned pays the party 10 gold each time they let him murder somebody, provided he can do whatever he wants with the body.
Ned offers 5 gold per body for the three goblins killed in the Barrow Mound's lower corridor; the party must hand the bodies over to him.
The Free Goblin Society would not want their dead compatriots defiled, so giving Ned the goblin bodies means sneaking them past the goblins.
